Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
LSJ,
A couple of situations came up in our local game last night.

If a minion makes an aggravated strike using a Wooden Stake for 2+
damage on a vampire, resulting in the vampire *burning from the
strike*, what is the path of the Wooden Stake?

Option 1: Agg Damage burns the vampire before the Stake gets to the
vampire
Option 2: Stake moves to the vampire (because of the 2+ damage and
text of the Stake) and then the vampire burns from the aggravated
damage.

Also, with Brother's Blood, is it intended to ONLY allow damage
preventions when a BB would go to torpor/be burned or can it be used
to prevent any damage, including damage which would send the BB in
combat to torpor?

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On Aug 17, 2:24 am, Juggernaut1981 <brasscompo...@gmail.com> wrote:

> LSJ,
> A couple of situations came up in our local game last night.
>
> If a minion makes an aggravated strike using a Wooden Stake for 2+
> damage on a vampire, resulting in the vampire *burning from the
> strike*, what is the path of the Wooden Stake?

The Wooden Stake is transfered after damage has been handled.
So if there's no opposing minion left, Wooden Stake isn't transfered.
http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/7afeec9e44d96037

> Option 1: Agg Damage burns the vampire before the Stake gets to the
> vampire
> Option 2: Stake moves to the vampire (because of the 2+ damage and
> text of the Stake) and then the vampire burns from the aggravated
> damage.
>
> Also, with Brother's Blood, is it intended to ONLY allow damage
> preventions when a BB would go to torpor/be burned or can it be used
> to prevent any damage, including damage which would send the BB in
> combat to torpor?

It can be used to heal or prevent destruction. Basically, it can be
used to prevent any damage done in combat (apart from the first agg,
which isn't healable nor would destroy the vampire).

Brother's Blood
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Sanguinus
Requires a ready Blood Brother of the same circle as another one in
combat.
[san] This vampire can burn his or her own blood to heal or prevent
destruction from damage taken by a member of this circle in combat.
[SAN] Put this card on this vampire. The vampire with this card can
burn his or her own blood to heal or prevent destruction from damage
taken by a member of this circle in combat. A vampire may have only
one Brother's Blood.

Wooden Stake
Stake
Cardtype: Equipment
Melee weapon.
Strike: strength damage. If more than 1 damage is inflicted on an
opposing vampire by this weapon in a given combat, that vampire is
sent to torpor. In that case, this card is transferred to that
vampire, and he or she doesn't untap as normal during the untap phase
as long as he or she remains in torpor.
